claims.statement: Behavior that the intent does not describe must not change.
Prices are cached to make price retrieval faster.
Tenant isolation continues to be enforced.

hypotheses.title: Stale cached price after underlying price table changes
hypotheses.suspected_behavior: price_for('tenant-b','widget') caches 35.0 on first call; if _PRICES['tenant-b']['widget'] is then updated to 99.0, head keeps returning cached 35.0 while base returns the new price.
hypotheses.expected_base: 99.0 on second call (live read of updated _PRICES)
hypotheses.expected_head: 35.0 on second call (stale value from first call)
hypotheses.test_intent: Clear _price_cache, call price_for('tenant-b','widget'), mutate _PRICES['tenant-b']['widget'] to 99.0, call price_for again and compare results; restore _PRICES and clear cache in finally.
hypotheses.falsification_criteria: If head returns the updated 99.0 after the price-table mutation, the hypothesis is wrong.
